concerns.yourWordsTitle: What you told us is troubling you

hearing.title: Consultation form
hearing.subtitle: Tell us about your situation. AI will connect you with the right support.
hearing.noPersonalInfoTitle: Please leave out anything that identifies you
hearing.noPersonalInfoBody: What you write here is visible to supporters before you approve them. Leave out your name, address, phone number, school or workplace, and tell us only about the situation. Your contact details are shared only after you approve a supporter, and only as far as needed.
hearing.whatHint: The more detail you give, the easier it is to find a supporter for you
hearing.whatPlaceholder: e.g. My parents belong to a religious group and refuse to let me see a doctor. I have had a high fever for a week but cannot get medical care.
hearing.whenLabel: Since when have you been struggling?
hearing.whenPlaceholder: e.g. For 3 months, since last spring
hearing.wantLabel: How would you like things to be?
hearing.wantPlaceholder: e.g. I want to receive treatment in a safe place, I want to live on my own terms
hearing.privacyNote: * What you write here is organized and analyzed by AI to find support organizations that fit your situation. It is shared with supporters only to the extent needed to help you.
hearing.aiStep3: Classifying the issues from an SDGs perspective...
hearing.errorAnswerRequired: Please answer at least one item in Q{id}
hearing.errorWhatRequired: Please fill in "What is happening right now?"
hearing.errorWhatTooLong: "What is happening right now?" must be {max} characters or less
hearing.errorTimeout: This is taking too long. Please try again in a little while.
hearing.errorUserFetch: Failed to load your account information
hearing.dangerLabel: My life or safety is in danger right now (e.g. I am being abused, I strongly feel like dying)
hearing.dangerNote: If checked, your request is treated as urgent and prioritized.
hearing.groupsTitle: What are you struggling with right now?
hearing.groupsHint: Pick as many as you like. If unsure, it is fine to choose "Hard to put into words / feeling alone".
hearing.itemsHint: It's fine if nothing applies. What you check is passed to supporters as your own words.
hearing.itemsUnsureNote: You don't have to check anything. Tell us in your own words below.
hearing.helpTitle: What kind of help would you like?
hearing.helpHint: Optional. It is fine if this changes later.
hearing.errorGroupRequired: Please choose at least one option under "What are you struggling with right now?"

form.heading: {event} Disaster SOS
form.noPersonalInfoTitle: Please leave out anything that identifies you
form.noPersonalInfoBody: What you write here is visible to supporters before you approve them. Leave out your name, full street address and phone number, and tell us only about the situation. Only the area you picked above is shared as your location.
form.lead: Don't worry about writing it perfectly — fill in only what you can. What you write goes directly to supporters.
form.q1Placeholder: e.g. My home was damaged and I am staying at a shelter
form.q2: Since when have you been struggling?
form.q2Placeholder: e.g. Since the day of the earthquake
form.q3: What would you like to happen?
form.q1Ex1: My home is too damaged to live in and I am staying at a shelter
form.q1Ex2: The water and power have been out and daily life is difficult
form.q1Ex3: I have small children or elderly family members and shelter life is very hard
form.q2Ex2: Things have been getting worse over the past few days
form.q3Ex1: I need somewhere to stay for now
form.q3Ex2: I need food and daily necessities
form.q3Ex3: I want someone to listen and connect me with the right support
form.requiredError: Please fill in at least "What is happening right now?"
form.note: No AI analysis is applied — what you write is registered as-is and treated as urgent.
form.limitNotice: You have reached the limit of active requests. Please check your existing requests on the dashboard.
form.doneBody: Supporters or our team will contact you. You can check the status on your dashboard anytime.
form.submitError: Failed to send. Please try again in a moment.
form.supplyNotice: As this service has just launched, there are not yet many local supporter organizations. Replies may take some time, but our team reviews every request and works to connect you with support.
form.specialNotice: This Disaster SOS is a limited-time special response for those affected by the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake. For other difficulties, you can always use our regular consultation service (also free).
form.doneWaitNote: Replies may take some time. Please rest assured that our team reviews every request.
